messages:
priya: Heads-up — PR #4827 (docs) flagged two small but user-facing issues: the curl/python auth header examples show `x-api-key` while our hosted API docs standardize on `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`, and the chat/generate example response shape mixes streaming fields with sync examples. cc @gina @tom @max

gina: saw it, thanks. Which files are affected exactly?

priya: docs/api/auth.md and docs/samples/chat_generate.json (the sample JSON under /api/chat in the openapi examples). Also the python snippet under docs/snippets/python/generate.md.

tom: I can take the auth header change. Will update both curl + python snippets to show `Authorization: Bearer` and add an explicit note about legacy `x-api-key` header for older SDK users.

max: quick note — some customers (legacy integrations) still use `x-api-key`. We should show both but mark the `x-api-key` as legacy and put a migration callout. Don't remove it from the Go example until SDKs are bumped.

priya: agreed. Plan: update examples to show canonical `Authorization` first, then a small `Legacy` collapsible showing `x-api-key`. Add a one-line migration note in the auth.md.

gina: about the chat sample: current example body shows `choices[0].message.text` and also includes a streaming snippet referencing `delta.content`. That confuses readers — we should split into two clear examples: Sync response (full message in choices[].message.content) and Streaming (server-sent events with delta chunks). Also update the OpenAPI example to match the sync shape.

tom: good catch. I'll add fenced code blocks: one for sync JSON response and one for SSE streaming events. Example sync snippet will be:
```json
{
  "id": "resp-123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [ { "index": 0, "message": { "role": "assistant", "content": "Here's the answer." }, "finish_reason": "stop" } ]
}
```
And streaming snippet will show `data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"He"}}]}` etc.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint found an invalid YAML sample in docs/samples/chat_generate.json: line 42 — unexpected indent.

priya: thanks bot — that explains the preview failures. Marking this P0 docs-blocker for the site preview.

tom: I'll fix the YAML indentation and push a wip branch `docs/3629995555-authstream-fix` with two commits: `auth-examples` and `chat-sync-vs-stream`. Opening PR now and linking to #4827. Requesting review from @priya and @gina.

max: when you push, please also update the Go/Python SDK snippet lines that set headers: show both `client.SetHeader("Authorization", "Bearer <API_KEY>")` and a one-line comment for legacy `x-api-key`.

gina: I'll review once CI is green. After merge, we should add a tiny CHANGELOG entry: "docs: clarify auth header examples and sync vs streaming shapes for chat generate".

priya: sounds good. If we resolve reviews today we can merge and regenerate the docs-preview. I'm marking the thread as blocker for the deploy.

tom: pushed and PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 — contains commentary and the two example blocks. Preview is queued.

priya: thanks! I'll do a quick pass after lunch.

gina: :thumbsup: will prioritize review.

max: also pinging SDK team to watch for any unplanned breakage.

tom: merged PR and deployed preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/docs/4827 — verify the auth examples and the two chat examples render as intended.

priya: verified the preview render and wording. Closing as solved, will merge final after changelog note.
